faqs.question: Does Electric 50 share Electric 40’s 0.4 m³ hopper so they place the same m³/h?
faqs.answer: No. Both list hopper 0.4 m³. Electric 50 lists 26 m³/h; Electric 40 lists 21 m³/h. Hopper litres are a grate buffer, not pumping output.

faqs.question: Is Diesel 40 the diesel copy of Electric 50’s 26 m³/h?
faqs.answer: Diesel 40 lists 4108 / 66 kW, 26 m³/h, 25 MPa, 120 m / 360 m (1 cm aggregate). Electric 50 lists 55 kW, 30 MPa, fine stone 150 m / 350 m. Same 26 m³/h cell, different power and distance rows. Open the matching page.
